Denton Women Cyclists Tuesday Social Ride

Denton, TX · Downtown · Social

Women / trans / femmeNo-dropBeginner friendly

Denton Women Cyclists Tuesday Social Ride is a social group ride in Denton, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 7:00 pm from Bayless-Selby House Museum parking lot. About 8–12 miles, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Denton Women Cyclists Tuesday Social Ride group ride

A no-drop ride for women, femme and non-binary riders. Eight to 12 miles at an easy 8 to 10 mph. Cancellations go up on the group's Facebook page.
